explication: Dozer is a macOS menu-bar utility for hiding and revealing groups of status icons. Its main workflow is menu-bar clicks or a configured shortcut → icon visibility changes; right-click opens preferences for behavior such as optional remove-icon toggling and delayed hiding. The graph also includes launch-time behavior, Dock visibility, login and update settings. The README documents these capabilities; some subsystem wiring is inferred only where the sampled source does not expose its implementation.
